system.name: ACC
system.one_liner: an ACK-driven congestion control scheme for lossless Ethernet that classifies flows from ACK marking and adjusts their sending rate

content.subject: how an ACC sender classifies a flow from aggregated ACK marking (CE/NO/UE) and picks a rate-adjustment action

elements.name: Receiving ACK
elements.role: entry pseudo-state where the sender reads each period's aggregated ACK marking

elements.name: Congested
elements.role: flow steadily marked CE above the threshold (90%), considered congested

elements.name: Uncongested
elements.role: flow with neither CE nor UE marking received, considered uncongested

elements.name: Undetermined
elements.role: victim flow that received UE marking but no CE marking

elements.name: Source Halt
elements.role: congested flow stops transmitting while its ACK arrival rate is recorded for later use

elements.name: Sending
elements.role: exit pseudo-state where the adjusted rate is applied and the flow keeps transmitting

relations.what: CE-marked ACK fraction above threshold during period T
NO: neither CE nor UE marking received
UE-marked ACK received, no CE marking
records ACK sequence / ACK arrival rate then halts sending
Rate decrease using the recorded ACK arrival rate
Rate keep or decrease, based on the UE marking duration pattern
next monitoring period's ACKs are read again (dashed feedback loop)

transitions.guard: record ACK sequence / ACK arrival rate

content.key_idea: An ACC sender classifies each flow every period by the priority-ordered ACK marking CE > UE > NO into Congested, Undetermined or Uncongested, and each class drives a distinct rate-adjustment path before looping back to read the next period's ACKs.
content.reading_order: left to right: Receiving ACK branches into three parallel rows (Congested/Uncongested/Undetermined) keyed by CE/NO/UE, each row's action leads right into Sending, which loops back along the bottom to Receiving ACK

palette.used_for: pale blue fill of the Congested / Uncongested / Undetermined state boxes

encoding.color_means: pale blue fill marks the three classification states (Congested/Uncongested/Undetermined); bold red and blue text on the CE/UE transition labels visible in the rendered figure calls out the triggering signal
encoding.line_style_means: dashed boxes/line mark the Receiving-ACK entry, the Sending exit, and the feedback edge between them; solid arrows mark the classification and rate-adjustment transitions
encoding.state_means: the three parallel congestion states are told apart by which incoming ACK-marking label (CE/NO/UE) drives them and by their distinct downstream rate action
encoding.marker_means: no numbered markers; short verb-phrase labels (CE, NO, UE, Rate decrease, Rate increase, Rate keep or decrease) name each transition's trigger or effect

evidence: Figure 5 illustrates the state machine of ACK-driven rate adjustment at ACC senders
TCD marking is aggregated in each T with the priority order CE > UE > NO
Only when neither UE nor CE marking is received, the flow is uncongested

summary: Figure 5 of this paper on lossless-Ethernet congestion control shows the ACC sender's ACK-driven state machine. Starting from Receiving ACK, the sender classifies each period's aggregated ACK marking by priority CE > UE > NO: a CE-marked ACK above a 90% threshold moves the flow to Congested, which first enters Source Halt (recording the ACK sequence and arrival rate) before a Rate decrease step; a UE-marked ACK with no CE moves the flow to Undetermined, driving a Rate keep or decrease; and no CE/UE marking leaves the flow Uncongested, which directly triggers a Rate increase. All three branches rejoin at Sending, which loops back (dashed arrow) to Receiving ACK for the next monitoring period. Pale-blue boxes mark the three classification states, and dashed boxes/lines mark the loop's start, end and feedback edge.
summary_zh: 该图展示ACC发送端按CE>UE>NO优先级对ACK标记分类的状态机：拥塞流先进入Source Halt记录ACK到达速率再降速，受害流按UE模式调速，未拥塞流直接提速，三者汇合到Sending后循环回到接收ACK。
